description: A React component for managing and displaying a modal to select users for direct messaging in Mattermost, including search, pagination, and capability checks.

classes.name: MoreDirectChannels
classes.description: A React component for selecting users to start direct or group channels, with search and pagination.

methods.name: loadModalData
methods.description: Loads user profiles, stats, and capabilities when modal is opened.

methods.name: checkDMCapabilities
methods.description: Checks if users can be directly messaged and caches the result.

methods.name: updateFromProps
methods.description: Updates component state based on new props, including search handling.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: React lifecycle method to trigger updates after props change.

methods.name: setUsersLoadingState
methods.description: Sets the loading state for user list.

methods.name: handleHide
methods.description: Hides the modal and resets search term.

methods.name: handleExit
methods.description: Handles modal exit, navigation, and focus restoration.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission of selected users to start a direct or group channel.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a user or group channel to the selection.

methods.name: addUsers
methods.description: Adds multiple users to the selection.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Debounced search function for filtering users.

methods.name: getDirectMessageableUsers
methods.description: Filters users based on direct message capability.
